bugs.error_message: After dying and respawning in Mission 1 the player is invisible and the world is frozen
bugs.root_cause: start_mission() hand-rolls its reset (no STATE.reset call, unlike m2-m6) and covers player_dead/death_timer/request_death_screen but not the death_anim_* fields. After death_anim.update_death_anim() set phase=2, a retry left death_anim_phase=2 + death_time_scale/accumulator stale: m1 update.game_update() early-returned via 'if STATE.player_dead' forever and should_skip_player_draw() (phase>=1) hid the standing player. Stale death_camera_tilt=12/offset=35 also kept apply_camera_tilt rotating every subsequent frame.
bugs.fix: Added death_anim.reset_stale_visuals() (phase, time_scale, accumulator, tilt, y_offset -> alive defaults) and call it from m1.start_mission() next to the existing death-flag resets.

bugs.fix: Tag light callbacks (fn.light); pack a 64 m physical-depth map into the colour target alpha; anchor-gate lights with a 3x3 kernel, per-pixel mask only partial lights, soft windows/haze; new hot-core + Bayer-dithered sodium ramp, distance-sized; ground spills to pools; beacon() for aviation lamps.

bugs.error_message: Shots miss the crosshair: first shot lands ~3.7 deg above the sight
bugs.root_cause: Recoil, cam_kick and pitch creep were applied before _aim_ray(), so the ray used the post-kick pitch while the crosshair (camera) stayed at the pre-kick sight.
bugs.fix: Build the aim ray and look pitch before the kick; the kick then moves the camera only.

bugs.error_message: Pellets rarely hit: no centre lane, yaw-only spread, small hit spheres
bugs.root_cause: PELLET_FAN was eight yaw-only offsets with no centre lane, so centre-line targets were missed past ~24 m; body sphere r0.42 and head r0.2 were tight.
bugs.fix: Eight (yaw, pitch) lanes around the crosshair with a centre lane; body r0.5, head r0.25.

bugs.error_message: Alex fires with no rifle in hand
bugs.root_cause: Allies were drawn with rifle_on=True but their spec has no rifle key, so _rifle stayed None and nothing was held; tracers started at a fixed point.
bugs.fix: New ('ally', name) hum branch with rifle=rifle; allies hold the rifle and fire from the joints muzzle.

bugs.error_message: Alex charges the player and rarely fires
bugs.root_cause: His walk goal was 1.2 m in front of Biribel and he fired only when standing still, so he was almost never stopped at range.
bugs.fix: Pick firing spots (LOS to target, clear path, leash 13 m on Biribel, flank and cover bonus), fire 3-round bursts, hang back when no spot.

bugs.error_message: No death animation for guards and dogs in the raid
bugs.root_cause: Guards blended to a lying pose in place over 0.45 s; dogs were a standing mesh that vanished after 0.8 s.
bugs.fix: Guards fall 0.55 s with a push away from the shooter; dogs roll onto their side (raid_world.dog_fall) and stay.

bugs.error_message: Abrupt prep to raid switch: no film, no fade

bugs.error_message: M4 siege loyalists froze at window and door edges, pressed against the wall
bugs.root_cause: Enemy._apply_move adds float steps to pygame.Rect ints, which truncate. A sideways component under 1 px was lost every frame, so a unit pinned on one axis never slid into the gap.
bugs.fix: siege._move keeps the sub-pixel remainder on the enemy (_m4_fx/_m4_fy) and passes whole pixels to _apply_move.
